title: Developer for Affordable Housing Plan
short_description: Canceled advance notice for affordable housing redevelopment planning and mixed-finance implementation.

No technical building sizes, areas, spans, or quantities are stated.
services: Design-build/developer services for affordable housing; planning/master planning; programming; civil engineering; geotechnical engineering; landscape architecture; structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a developer-led affordable housing redevelopment, not a structurally distinctive bridge, roof, stadium, or special structure project.
- Building type is standard residential/public housing with no stated large spans, complex structural systems, or innovative lightweight construction.
- Includes structural and civil engineering disciplines, but the procurement focus is on developer services rather than core structural design.
- Advance notice has been canceled and is not expected to be re-advertised, reducing strategic relevance further.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The notice only mentions redevelopment of public housing stock through RAD, demolition, disposition, and new construction, without quantities, unit counts, floor areas, or budget figures; therefore no realistic USD estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the source, and the canceled advance notice does not contain enough scope detail for a reliable fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Developers of affordable housing to plan, finance, and implement affordable housing using a mixed-finance and mixed-income approach. Disciplines requested include design-build/developer, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, planning/master planning, and structural engineering.
